comparison.objective: Extract a retaining pin while supporting a load-bearing carriage.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual support transfer and controlled fastener extraction under load.
comparison.success_condition: Available evidence requires pin removal without unsafe carriage descent; detailed numeric rubric fields are absent.
comparison.reason: Despite involving removal and load control, its outcome is extraction of an intact structural pin while supporting a carriage. It does not test coaxial break-off tooling, hammering a manufactured notch, or collecting multiple released tangs; missing numeric thresholds do not create plausible duplication.
